visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a black T-shirt and a white pearl necklace, stands in front of a gray wall with the word 'eman' in gold lettering. She smiles broadly while speaking directly into the camera. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setting. (2) The scene shifts to a retail-like environment with glass display cases. The woman is joined by a young man wearing a purple T-shirt. They are looking at shelves filled with electronic products including a GeForce RTX 4090 box and various headphone boxes. They pick up and examine several boxes, including a 'Level' smart lock. (3) The man is now sitting on a gray sofa in a brightly lit indoor space with large windows and white curtains. He holds a white Canon calculator mouse box and shows it to the woman. Beside him are other items like a black watch box and a large Lego Land Rover Defender box. (4) The woman and man stand together, holding up two white rectangular plates with portraits of people on them. The background is a modern living room with a neutral-colored sofa and minimalist decor. (5) In a final sequence, they stand in front of a shelf filled with toys and collectibles. They hold up 'Demon Slayer' themed bath bomb packages and a fishing rod box featuring anime characters. The woman points toward the man and then to a red app icon appearing as a graphic overlay.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The woman has short black hair, wears a black T-shirt and a pearl necklace. The man has short black hair and wears a purple T-shirt and blue jeans.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An office environment with glass display shelves filled with tech hardware, a modern living room area with a light-colored sofa, and a studio wall with gold brand lettering.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by a bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar and drum BGM. A 'pop' SFX punctuates her initial greeting. (2) A transition is marked by a 'whoosh' SFX as a male voice joins. The two engage in a fast-paced dialogue. Sounds of cardboard boxes being shifted and plastic rustling are audible under the voices. (3) A 'ding' SFX sounds when a specific product is highlighted. The male speaker's pitch remains casual but slightly deeper than the female host's high-arousal tone. (4) The BGM continues steadily as the sound of a box lid being opened creates a light 'thud'. Laughter from both speakers is heard. (5) Another 'whoosh' and a cartoon-style 'boing' SFX accompany the presentation of the Lego box. The audio density is high, with near-continuous speech overlapping the melodic BGM. (6) The final phase features a synthesized stinger as the host promotes an app, with the BGM fading out slightly to emphasize the call-to-action.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video features creator Taiwanniu visiting Joeman's office to 'raid' his tech collection for a charity auction. It serves as a promotional collaboration between the two influencers to drive users to the 'Tsubi' app for the sale of these items.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The host explicitly names the app '厝' (Tsubi) and points to its icon on screen, encouraging viewers to download it to find the items shown.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production value social media short with rapid editing and heavy use of on-screen text to maintain high engagement.
